text: Viking 1 lander touched down on Mars in Chryse Planitia on July 20, 1976.
Its surface sampler arm scooped the first sample of Martian soil on July 28, 1976.
Designed for a primary mission of 90 days, Viking 1 operated on Mars for over six years.
Final transmission Nov 11, 1982 per NASA (some sources say Nov 13).
safe_text: NASA records the final transmission on November 11, 1982 (some sources cite November 13).

text: Viking 1 was powered continuously through Martian nights and dust by two SNAP-19 radioisotope thermoelectric generators.
The lander descended through the thin Martian atmosphere using an aeroshell heat shield, a parachute, and terminal descent thrusters.
